verses.4:143: مُّذَبۡذَبِينَ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ لَآ إِلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَلَآ إِلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ سَبِيلࣰ ا

meaning: The root ذبذب (dhbdhb) primarily describes a state of wavering, oscillation, or being in suspense between two things.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
